component.name: FoxRes
component.summary: The resistor toolkit, from color codes to 4–20 mA loops

description.p: FoxRes is an exact resistor toolkit for anyone who designs, builds, repairs or commissions electronics and instrumentation.

ul.li: SMD markings: 3-digit, 4-digit, R notation and EIA-96
Nearest E3 to E192 standard value (IEC 60063)
Best two- and three-resistor combinations for any value
Voltage divider design with tolerance and loading
Package power and voltage limits with temperature derating
Any number of resistors in series or parallel
Pt100/Pt1000 RTDs to IEC 60751 with tolerance classes
NTC thermistors: Beta and Steinhart–Hart, with a three-point fit
4–20 mA loops: scaling, NAMUR NE43 status, loop budget and HART
Wire resistance by AWG or mm², and PCB trace resistance and IPC-2221 current

description.p: Every tool also runs from the command line, with JSON output for scripts. Every color code and SMD code is checked by exhaustive tests, and results are cross-checked against brute force and published reference tables.

screenshot.caption: Decode or generate resistor color bands
Nearest standard value in any E-series
Voltage divider design with tolerance and loading
Power and package check with derating
4–20 mA loop scaling, NE43 status and loop budget

description.p: FoxRes becomes a complete resistor toolkit, with 13 new tools: voltage dividers, LED resistors, Ohm's law, package power and derating, series and parallel networks, tolerance analysis, drift and noise, RTDs, NTC thermistors, 4–20 mA loops, Wheatstone bridges, wire and PCB traces. Three-resistor combinations, a new adaptive sidebar, and every tool on the command line.
First release: color bands, SMD codes, E-series values, two-resistor combinations and a command-line interface.
